purpose: Thesis title/attribution conflicts between his supplied list (harvest/theses/supervised-theses.json) and the corpus, and how they were settled.
his_rule_2026_08_27: When names or titles are mixed up, DOWNLOAD THE THESIS AND READ THE TITLE PAGE. The PDF's own title page — author, title, degree, month/year, thesis supervisor — outranks every secondary source: his list, the group bibtex, the old theses page, and publications.json. MIT DSpace holds the official copy (dspace.mit.edu); groups.csail.mit.edu/cag/rio and commit.csail.mit.edu hold local copies of some. Read the page, do not infer from a filename or a citation.
